prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated distant landmark layer for a premium pixel-art side-scroller, 1024x1024.
Create Rio's Christ the Redeemer statue standing on Corcovado mountain at night. Recognizable small front-facing pale stone statue with outstretched horizontal arms, lit softly ivory/cool cyan, its small stone pedestal on top of a broad dark rugged mountain. Statue is ONLY 15% of image height, from y=15% to y=30%, centered x=50%; the atmospheric navy/teal mountain begins at the pedestal and broadens to fill the bottom edge. Distant scale, not a close-up sculpture. Mountain with crisp hand-painted pixel clusters, dark blue rocky facets, sparse tiny amber city lights at base, no bright green foliage. Shape should have a natural irregular silhouette. Entire mountain/landmark opaque, and everything OUTSIDE silhouette is a completely flat vivid #00FF00 green chroma-key background (including all space around the statue's arms). No green spill or green glow on subject. Upper 10% empty green margin. This is a layering asset, no separate sky or rectangle behind the mountain. Detailed restrained pixel-art in Katana ZERO-like nighttime atmosphere, no outlines around bounding box, no UI, no text, no people besides the statue, no cars, no watermark.
